reason: I'm back at work and the only exercise that actually happens for me is a class I've booked with other mums. A solo 45-minute video on my lounge-room floor is exactly the thing I'd skip every night, so I wouldn't even get through the free 5 weeks, let alone pay.
objection: I can't find 45 minutes a day with a baby and a job, and doing it alone at home there's nobody expecting me to turn up.
would_change_my_mind: Short 15-20 minute sessions plus some kind of group or live check-in with other mums so there's accountability, ideally with a women's health physio involved.
